Pauline Aldon Boral thanks for sharing this, yeah I see, my husband even tried one more time to register the marriage and change his status from single to married, they asked for a new personal status, and they even said it’s not related to how many times I left the country or not, they clearly want a new one, showed them the old one and its not useful anymore.
At some point the clerk even said : But anyway you didn’t left the country to get married, like i could’ve get married 2 times in Utah
